mapper.select: SELECT SMS_GROUP_ID, SMS_GROUP_NAME FROM SMS_RECEIVER_GROUP WHERE ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} ORDER BY SMS_GROUP_ID limit 1
SELECT a.RTU_ID, a.RTU_NAME, b.SMS_IDX FROM RTU_INFO AS a LEFT JOIN SMS_EQUIPMENT AS b ON a.RTU_ID = b.RTU_ID WHERE a.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} ORDER BY a.RTU_NAME

SELECT A.IDX, A.USER_NAME, AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(A.MOBILE), MD5(#{organ_code})) as MOBILE, A.MEMO, A.SMS_GROUP_ID, B.SMS_GROUP_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '1') AS GROUP1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '2') AS GROUP2
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '3') AS GROUP3
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '3') AS GROUP3
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '3') AS GROUP3, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '4') AS GROUP4, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '5') AS GROUP5
FROM SMS_RECEIVER A LEFT JOIN SMS_RECEIVER_GROUP B ON A.SMS_GROUP_ID = B.SMS_GROUP_ID WHERE B.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND A.USER_NAME LIKE '%".$_REQUEST['search_text']."%'
AND B.SMS_GROUP_NAME LIKE '%".$_REQUEST['search_text']."%'
AND A.MEMO LIKE '%".$_REQUEST['search_text']."%'
ORDER BY A.USER_NAME
